lfsr_deg24.description:
A server generates a keystream with a linear feedback shift register (LFSR), but it leaked 64 consecutive output bits of the LFSR keystream.
Predict the next 16 bits (the secret) with Berlekamp-Massey.

bits = 1111111111111111111111110101010101010101011010100110011001101110
lfsr_deg24.note: 24 级 Fibonacci LFSR 密钥流：泄露 64 位，预测随后 16 位
